tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently purchased a new laptop for school, and you are satisfied with the purchase. However, you noticed some issues with its performance. You need to contact customer service to resolve this issue. Write an email to customer service.
bullets: Explain what you liked about the laptop.
Describe the issues with the laptop performance.
Suggest a resolution for this issue.
tasks.subject: Recent Laptop Purchase
